organization.name: Thunderbird / MZLA Technologies Corporation
organization.notes: 2003 is Thunderbird project start, not MZLA incorporation. MZLA is a for-profit wholly owned subsidiary of not-for-profit Mozilla.org. Individual/business contributions sustain the project; donations are not equity investments. No equity investor identities or complete funding history verified.

pricingTiers.name: Thunderbird Desktop
pricingTiers.notes: Desktop client is free forever. Mail account/service required separately; optional Thundermail excluded.
No public Most popular or Recommended plan designation found in the source inspected; no popularity inferred.
No separately priced business edition of desktop client shown; full desktop available to organizations.
No paid Enterprise desktop edition shown; optional separate services do not establish client license price.

moats.claim: Long-lived cross-platform mail workflows and an add-on ecosystem create familiarity and extensibility advantages, while standard email protocols keep the moat limited.

productReasons.claim: A unified inbox manages multiple mail accounts without separate browser sessions.
Calendar, contacts and tasks connect email to personal planning in one app.
Add-ons extend the desktop client for specialized workflows beyond the included interface.

sponsorship.notes: Donation/About pages identify for-profit MZLA as sustaining organization. No named separate corporate financial or in-kind sponsors found there; business steward fallback used, not nonprofit parent as sponsor.

requirements.notes: Windows, macOS or GNU/Linux; packaged binaries avoid build dependencies.

requirements.component: Mail account and IMAP/POP/SMTP or compatible mail service
requirements.notes: This is a mail client; not an email server or hosting provider.
glibc 2.17+, GTK+ 3.14+, libglib 2.42+, libstdc++ 4.8.1+, X.Org 1.0+ required; DBus/NetworkManager/PulseAudio recommended.

resources.cpu: Windows: 1 GHz or faster Intel/AMD; Mac: Intel x86 or Apple Silicon
resources.memory: Windows recommended: 1 GB (2 GB for 64-bit); macOS: 512 MB
resources.storage: Windows: 500 MB; macOS: 200 MB, plus mailbox data
resources.notes: Official version 157.0 requirements inspected. These are recommended desktop hardware values, not server sizing or build requirements.

selfHosting.notes: Local desktop installation; no external SQL/cache/queue server required. Existing mailbox service needed for mail. Source build requirements deliberately excluded.

oneClickInstall.notes: Desktop download installers offered for Windows/macOS/Linux; no server marketplace or one-click self-host deployment applies.
